name: Analytic-Splatting Gradient Computation
aliases: Gradient of 2D Gaussian integral w.r.t covariance matrix
definition: Computes the exact gradient of the analytically integrated 2D Gaussian splat intensity with respect to the elements of the 2D covariance matrix (Σ̂_11, Σ̂_12, Σ̂_22) to enable differentiable training of Gaussian splat parameters.
summary: Analytic-Splatting Gradient Computation calculates the exact gradient of 2D Gaussian splat intensity with respect to the covariance matrix by propagating derivatives through eigen-decomposition to account for pixel boundary effects.
